task: ae.geom exact integer computational geometry: orientation/segment relations, convex hull, polygon location, calipers diameter, closest pair, Shamos-Hoey sweep
reasoning_summary: Used exact long cross products (coords capped at 1e9 so they fit) and BigInteger rational comparison in the sweep. Differential tests against all-triples, O(n^2) and brute-force oracles on tiny coordinate ranges forced degeneracies; mutations of sweep event order, strip test, ray rule, touching rule and winding check were all killed. One test expectation (a near miss that actually crosses) was wrong and fixed.
